resources.string: Shared space
Refresh files
A dedicated home for desktop files
Files live in this app’s private storage across sessions unless deleted. The remote computer can access only this space when you explicitly share it.

Import copies the files you choose, not your phone folders. Originals are unchanged and never automatically synchronized. While shared, new imports are also available to the remote session. Export your work explicitly.

Export creates a new file in your chosen folder without overwriting. If a file is busy, close it in the remote app, then refresh and retry; the desktop need not disconnect.
Shared-space limits: 1 GiB total, 512 MiB per file, 4096 entries, 16 folder levels, with 128 MiB local space reserved. Import batches: up to 64 regular files, 512 MiB each and 1 GiB total.

Share this space as a remote drive?
Request an “RdpSync” drive in the remote file manager. Only this app’s Shared space is shared, including files added while shared, not phone storage or import-source folders.
Drive redirection is enabled when connecting, so the desktop briefly disconnects. Save remote work first. Servers may disable redirection; requesting a drive does not mean it was accepted.
Allow remote file changes
Read-only · browse and copy remotely
Read/write · create, change and delete remotely
The remote computer and its session apps can create, modify, rename or delete files in Shared space. Changes take effect immediately and remain after disconnecting. Keep backups of important files.
I allow remote changes and deletion inside Shared space
Changes are not written back or synchronized to import sources. Export explicitly to save elsewhere on the phone. Canceling or closing this dialog does not enable sharing.

On Windows, open File Explorer → This PC → Redirected drives and folders and look for RdpSync. Other servers may show it elsewhere.
The remote file manager may retain a stale drive icon. It does not prove access is still authorized or data was saved.
If the drive is unavailable, you can separately try Send files / Receive files via clipboard if the server supports it. That is not a shared drive.
Set up shared drive…
Stop this session’s sharing access?

Remote apps will lose access to Shared space. In-progress saves may fail or be incomplete. Close remote files first. Stopping sharing does not delete the workspace or undo authorized writes or deletions. Pending accepted deletes can complete when file handles close.
Stop sharing now
The server must accept the shared drive. Server policy may disable redirection; check its actual status after connecting.

Closing this dialog does not stop authorized sharing. Stop sharing or disconnect to revoke access; already-authorized changes or pending deletions are not undone. Shared space is never automatically synchronized to import sources.

Delete from Shared space?
This permanently deletes the item from this app’s Shared space and removes remote access to it. Folders must be empty. Import-source files and previously exported copies are not deleted.
